messages:
incident-bot: :warning:  Alert: elevated 5xx and pod churn in encoder-service (prod) — canary failing readiness checks after deploy. Paging oncall.
ryan: oncall here. seeing 5xx spike from 12:31 UTC. @nina can you grab the deploy details?
nina: i triggered a canary ~4m ago: encoder-service v3.0.0-canary (helm chart encoder/values: hpa.targetCPU=5 not 50 — looks wrong). checking pods
nina: `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep encoder-canary`
```
encoder-canary-0    0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  2         3m
encoder-canary-1    0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  2         2m
```
oliver: logs show init container failing due to missing config path mounted from configmap:
```
kubectl logs encoder-canary-0 -n prod -c init-config
Error: /etc/encoder/conf.yaml not found
FATAL: init container failed, exit 1
```
trish: the chart template changed the configmap name to `encoder-conf-v3` while the values still point to `encoder-conf`. looks like a templating mismatch.
nina: that would explain init failure. but why traffic hit canary? we have feature flag `router.use_v3` enabled for 10% — we should kill the flag to stop routing to canary while we remediate.
ryan: agree flip flag now. @deploy-bot can you toggle `router.use_v3` off?
deploy-bot: Feature flag `router.use_v3` set to OFF for prod (targeted rollout paused).
ops-bot: Note: HPA for encoder had target CPU scaled down to 5 in the new helm values (typo). with node gke-encoder-2 under drain earlier, autoscaler couldn't provision extra pods.
ryan: i'm patching the deployment to use the stable configmap name as stop-gap, and patching HPA minReplicas to 3 so we don't hit zero. applying now.
nina: commands:
```
kubectl patch deployment encoder-deployment -n prod --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/volumes/0/configMap/name","value":"encoder-conf"}]'
kubectl patch hpa encoder-hpa -n prod --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'
```
ryan: applied both patches. new init containers now progressing, pods creating.
ops-bot: Event: scaled up to 3 replicas (hpa). Node gke-encoder-2 still draining (ETA ~10m).
trish: new pods become Ready but then one new replica fails liveness probe — liveness path in v3 was `/livez` while our liveness probe expects `/healthz`. the manifest changed probe path in the chart too.
oliver: ok that's a separate regression in the chart — we'll revert the probe path to `/healthz` on the deployment to restore stability.
ryan: perform quick rollback of chart probe path and image to v2.9.4 which was last-known-good.
deploy-bot: initiating rollback: set encoder-deployment image=encoder:v2.9.4, update livenessProbe path to /healthz.
deploy-bot: rollout progressing -> 100% updated.
ops-bot: New pods (v2.9.4) are Ready. Metrics show 5xx rate back to baseline within ~6 minutes.
cs-rep: Customer impact? need copy for status page.
ryan: impact window ~12:31-12:38 UTC. Roughly 9 customers experienced elevated errors; most small-volume. No data integrity issues. SLO breach for 7 minutes.
nina: I'll draft status: "We experienced elevated inference errors due to a canary rollout with mismatched chart values (configmap + probe path) and an unintended HPA CPU target typo. Traffic was routed away and service restored after we paused the rollout, patched HPA, and reverted to the prior image. Postmortem to follow."
trish: assign postmortem to @nina and @oliver for chart regression, and @ryan for oncall handling & mitigation.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. Postmortem owners: nina, oliver, ryan.
ryan: handing monitoring to nina for next 90m; i'll coordinate with CS to send the status update.
nina: taking monitoring. will post if we see any regressions. adding followups: 1) add helm CI lint rule to detect configmap name drift, 2) add probe path smoke tests in canary job, 3) add a helm values guard to prevent improbable HPA targets (<10 or >90).
cs-rep: Sending status update to affected accounts now. I'll include timeline and mitigation steps and offer escalation as needed.
ryan: thanks team. i'll close thread but leave it unlocked for updates. :white_check_mark:
